text:
mika: Heads-up: Android sample flaky on streaming when SDK retry enabled. Repro in emulator: socket reset then our retry duplicates parts of the stream.

raj: Which retry layers? OkHttp vs SDK?

mika: Both. We ship OkHttp default client plus SDK RetryPolicy. OkHttp may retry lower-level which conflicts with our higher-level attempts for non-idempotent streams.

emily: Any stacktrace?

mika: Snippet: 
```
W/okhttp.OkHttpClient: java.net.SocketException: Connection reset by peer
 at okhttp3.internal.connection.RealConnection.connectSocket(RealConnection.kt:XXX)
```

raj: Short term: in sample set okHttpClient.retryOnConnectionFailure(false) and tune dispatcher/connection pool. Longer: expose disableAutomaticRetries in Kotlin builder for Android.

emily: Also saw a token refresh race when 401 arrives and retries are queued. Might need single-flight refresh for coroutines.

ci-bot: CI run queued for branch fix/android-retry (android-emulator).

mika: Plan: patch sample to disable SDK retries by default on Android, add README guidance, and follow up with builder flag + tests. Will open PRs today.

raj: Add note to migration guide about idempotency tokens vs retry semantics.

emily: Filed ticket to revisit streaming resumption vs full-retry semantics.

mika: Thanks — PR links incoming. :thumbsup:
